metrics.profile_summary: Senior growth-focused digital marketing professional with extensive expertise in SEO, PPC, and social media. Proven track record in scaling digital products and leading teams across diverse industries including SaaS and E-commerce.

experience.description: Managed global SEO, email, content, and PPC for PureVPN. Optimized sales funnels and led a 5-member team focusing on automation and analytics.
Managed B2B SEO for NetSuite and Salesforce, executing keyword research, website audits, and performance reporting.
Led on-page/off-page SEO and social media marketing for branded campaigns, including Logo Design Guru and DesignMantic.

strengths: Extensive experience in Meta Ads and social media growth
Strong data-driven mindset with proven ROAS and revenue achievements
Advanced proficiency in marketing analytics and automation tools
weaknesses: Significantly overqualified for a Specialist role
No explicit mention of Canva or TikTok specifically
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly seasoned digital marketer who far exceeds the minimum requirements. His expertise in Meta ads, content strategy, and reporting makes him an ideal, albeit overqualified, fit for the role.
